title: Battelle Memorial Institute linked to gifted-and-talented programs and the UFO cabal

tellings.quote: um a link between Battel Memorial Institute and these gifted and talented education system and the Cabal running these UFO programs

plain: Michels says there is a link between the Battelle Memorial Institute, a private research organisation, the US school programmes for gifted and talented children, and a secret group he calls 'the Cabal' that is said to run the government's UFO programmes. He raises this in an episode with the UFO researcher Steven Greer and credits it to a senior government official he does not name. If true, it would mean the group behind the UFO secrets also reaches into how bright children are picked out and taught.
